title: [Request] hope support searxng live searching
body: ### 🥰 需求描述 add Live web search and browsing baseon searxng API Base URL, plugin on store only support google and bing,it's not fast and full configurable searxng is a opensource project which can deploy on local docker. ### 🧐 解决方案 add built in plugin agent live searching skills like anything llm ### 📝 补充信息
